title: Synthetic Customer Reference Record
description: Frozen synthetic customer reference schema for the proof-of-address verification MVP. Reference truth contains only customer fields required for deterministic comparison.
$comment: DATA-01 v1.0.0. Synthetic/fake data only. Document fields, verification findings, risk indicators, ML outputs, policy evidence, and human decisions are intentionally excluded.

customer_id.description: Stable synthetic identifier used to select the reference customer.

customer_name.description: Synthetic customer name used as reference truth.

address.description: Synthetic customer address used as reference truth.

postal_code.description: Synthetic postal code stored as text so formatting and leading zeroes are preserved.
